fusions.name: Gathered Haul
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. Draws a thread rake across it for 9 damage, up to 1.6 times that at maximum range.

fusions.name: Combing Pass
fusions.desc: Every enemy within 3.5 tiles of you takes 3 damage. Each hit has a 25% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Drawing Pull
fusions.desc: A challenge that pulls up to 5 enemies within 8 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Leavings Kept
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 8 mana. Once every 4 seconds.
